_comment: Trusted knowledge source registry (M49, D16/D17). Consumed by src/lib/knowledge/registry.ts::parseRegistry. `schemaVersion` MUST match REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION or the registry is rejected as incompatible. Each source's `trustLevel` MUST be exactly "official" or "omnilink-notes" and `license` one of the recorded SourceLicense values. `path` points at a bundled pack under data/knowledge/. Only D16-legal sources ship by default: official ExpressLRS reference docs (GPL-3.0-or-later, the ExpressLRS project license) and OmniLink's own curated notes (CC-BY-4.0). New sources are admitted ONLY through src/lib/knowledge/allowlist.ts.
